title: cdk-construct-http-api-gateway examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-http-api-gateway/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — bare API, no routes
- with-routes/ — routes + Lambda integrations
- with-jwt-authorizer/ — JWT authorizer (divergent: adds authorizer resource)
- with-custom-domain/ — dnsName + acmCertificateArn from bridge fixture + route53ZoneIds (divergent: adds domain name + DNS record)
- with-vpc-link/ — vpcLinks for private integrations (divergent: adds VPC Link resource)
- with-cors/ — corsConfiguration

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/http-api-gateway-examples.test.ts.
